_about: Rimay color and type tokens. Decided D24 (SOT.md). The app imports these; never hard-code a color.
rules: Teal (action) is the only color for primary actions.
Red (block) only means 'Rimay did not say it' or a failed teach-back item. Never decorative.
Warnings always carry an icon, never color alone.
The textile strip (stepped pattern, textileA + textileB) is the only ornament: one thin band under the header. Never red.
Chaski always sits on a card with the chaskiCardTop -> chaskiCardBottom gradient.
